reviews.title: Beast of a setup for the money
reviews.comment: Really happy with this setup. The board feels really solid and everything looks to be very high quality and the processor is a beast playing various FPS games on medium to high and some ultra graphics settings I've never seen it go past 50% CPU usage playing a game with a bunch of other stuff running in the background.
reviews.author: Matthew

reviews.title: Very poor quality motherboard
reviews.comment:
I bought 2 of these motherboard CPU combinations to rebuild my wife's and my computers because they could not be upgraded to Windows 11.  The first one for my computer would not boot up with more than one memory card installed.  I have been using it but the screen jumps and sometimes goes blank for a second or two.
My wife's worked fine for about two months then screen would go blank and computer would not come back on.  After forcing a shut down it would not reboot.  This motherboard obviously has quality problem. I have rebuilt my wife's computer a cheaper MSI board and it is so far working fine.
reviews.author: Meterman
